question: Kelucharan Mohapatra won recognition in which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** won recognition in the dance form of **Odissi.**
 
• Odissi is a **classical dance** form that originated in the state of **Odisha** in eastern India.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra is considered one of the **pioneers of Odissi dance** and played a crucial role in popularizing the dance form.
 
• He received several awards and honors for his contributions to** Odissi dance**, including the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi** is another classical dance form that originated in the state of **Andhra Pradesh** in southern India.
 
• It is known for its **graceful movements and intricate footwork.**
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form that originated in the state of **Assam** in northeastern India.
 
• It is known for its **devotional and spiritual themes.**
 
• **Chhau** is a traditional dance form that is popular in the eastern states of India, particularly in **West Bengal, Jharkhand, and Odisha.**
 
• It is known for its **acrobatic movements and colorful masks.**
